content: {"praised":["Singing performances by Netrebko and Garanca are outstanding.","Vocal quality and dramatic intensity are incredible.","Production showcases strong bel canto standards.","Characters portrayed with depth and humanity.","Music remains powerful and moving."],"criticized":["2011 Vienna production considered overrated.","Staging and costumes described as basic and modern.","Voice and acting compared unfavorably to 1986 version.","Henry's singer not as impressive as Met counterpart.","Production lacks the drama of earlier performances."]}
